overview: Nursing assistants give hands-on care to patients in hospitals, nursing homes and home health. They help people bathe, dress, eat and move, answer call lights, take vital signs and tell nurses about changes. O*NET rates knowledge of customer service at 3.92 out of 5 for this job and active listening at 3.62. Training is short: most complete a state-approved program of several weeks and pass a certification exam to become a CNA. The BLS May 2025 median is $42,260 across 1,448,910 jobs. The work is physical, on your feet and follows clear instructions.
pay: Nursing assistants earn a median of $42,260, and the range is narrow: the top 10% earn $51,980 or more. Oregon has the highest state median at $49,830, 18% above the national figure. California has the most jobs, 110,060, at a median of $47,630, while Florida has 96,960 at $37,510.

faq.q: How much do nursing assistants make?
faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $42,260 a year. The middle half earn between $37,260 and $47,220. Oregon, Washington ($49,180) and New York ($48,590) pay the most, while Mississippi ($31,520) and Louisiana ($30,510) have the lowest state medians. Night and weekend shifts can pay more.

faq.q: How do you become a nursing assistant?
faq.a: Most complete a short state-approved training program and pass a competency exam to become a Certified Nurse Aide (CNA). In O*NET data, 39% have a high school diploma and 24% a post-secondary certificate. Community colleges, hospitals and the Red Cross offer programs.

faq.q: Is being a nursing assistant hard?
faq.a: It is physically and emotionally demanding. In O*NET data the job ranks above 88% of U.S. jobs for time on your feet and above 87% for working with people. You lift and move patients and face exposure to infection, so teamwork and good lifting technique matter.

faq.q: What can nursing assistants do next?
faq.a: Licensed practical nurses are a 91% match and earn $64,400, 52% more. Registered Nurses are an 84% match and earn $97,550, 131% more, according to BLS May 2025 data. Many nursing assistants work while studying for one of these licenses.
